description: The pie chart represents the distribution of different biases in a particular context, comparing the proportions of four categories. The chart is divided into four slices, each representing a distinct bias. The slices are labeled as "Right bias" (blue, 30%), "Left center bias" (red, 20%), "No bias/Neutral" is not present, instead "Left bias" (orange, 28%) and another category (green, 22%) is labeled inside the chart as (22). The chart includes percentage labels inside each slice, and the slices are arranged in no particular order. The chart does not include a legend, and no slices are visually emphasized. The proportions of the slices are clearly visible, with "Right bias" being the largest and "Left center bias" being the smallest.
